svg.text: CJ1 2.s3 Order / book · EA 5-layer drill-down (level 2) · v0.1 · 10 Nov 2026

Target (Marcel, 10 Nov): guest phone → «Co27» Maki Shop, our own booking and ordering web app (to build) → Kobas API v3 for reads and for reservation and customer writes · Deliverect Channel API for the order write (to verify) · Trifft API for member, coupons and points · Stripe for payment. Kobas stays the till and the system of record. The shop replaces the Kobas CIC front end and the Dojo booking widget: first step of a gradual migration.

Kobas API v3: REST, JSON, base api.kobas.co.uk/v3, OAuth2 client credentials (POST oauth.kobas.co.uk/access_token, token lasts 1 h), headers Bearer + x-kobas-company-id, pull only, no webhooks. Trifft: base api.trifft.io/v1, Bearer token. Deliverect: api.deliverect.com, OAuth2, channel scope.
